The '''Mandalore Banking Center''' was located in [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==History==
{{Quote|Open the bank. We're here for a withdrawal.|Lom Pyke to the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] outside the bank|<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a team composed of [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and forces of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] attacked this bank as a part of the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]]. [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] would take control of the city and overthrow [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] by pretending to save the city from the gangsters. The strike team entered the bank, then exited soon after, setting off an explosive near the entrance as they were chased by Mandalorian police. As they ran, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] arrived with Death Watch forces, briefly dueled with Opress, and then "captured" Opress, Pyke, and the rest of the team.
